title: Efficiency and Safety of High-frequency Radio Wave Electrotherapy With a Radio Frequency of 448 kHz in the Treatment of Patients With Organic Erectile Dysfunction.
brief_summary: Efficiency and safety of high-frequency radio wave electrotherapy with a radio frequency of 448 kHz in the treatment of patients with organic erectile dysfunction. Sham comparator, parallel study including both the main and control group to demonstrate the efficiency of the device to treat erectile dysfunction.
